parameters.name: ChildInstanceRegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the network instance.                   

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

- **VPC**: virtual private cloud.

- **VBR**: virtual border router.

- **CCN**: Cloud Connect Network.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging query. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.
